lines: Hazaaron khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle
couplets.en: I have a thousand desires, and each could take my dying breath.

lines: Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
couplets.en: Many of my longings came to pass, and still too few.

lines: Nikalna khuld se Aadam ka sunte aaye hain lekin
couplets.en: We have long heard how Adam was driven out of Eden.

lines: Bahut be-aabroo ho kar tere kooche se hum nikle
couplets.en: I left your street with my honor in tatters.

lines: Mohabbat mein nahin hai farq jeene aur marne ka
couplets.en: In love, living and dying feel much the same.

lines: Usi ko dekh kar jeete hain jis kaafir pe dam nikle
couplets.en: The sight of that faithless beloved keeps me alive and takes my breath away.

lines: Hazaaron khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle
couplets.en: I have a thousand desires, and each could take my dying breath.

lines: Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
couplets.en: Many of my longings came to pass, and still too few.

lines: Khuda ke waaste parda na Kaabe se utha, zaalim
couplets.en: For God's sake, cruel one, leave the Kaaba veiled.

lines: Kahin aisa na ho yaan bhi wahi kaafir sanam nikle
couplets.en: What if that same faithless idol were to appear here too?

lines: Kahaan maikhaane ka darwaaza, Ghalib, aur kahaan waaiz
couplets.en: What business has a preacher at the tavern door, Ghalib?

lines: Par itna jaante hain kal woh jaata tha ke hum nikle
couplets.en: All I know is that yesterday he was on his way there as I came out.
